evidence.detail: Every sort onClick uses table.sort.bind(table, ...) — 10+ bind calls in this file alone
onChange={queryChanged.bind(this)} and movePage.bind usages inside the class render method
bind appears in decktable.jsx, cardtable.jsx, persontable.jsx, headtoheadtable.jsx, matchtable.jsx, rotationtable.jsx, leaderboardtable.jsx, table.jsx, grid.jsx — well over 150 call sites total

triage.notes: The mechanical change per site is trivial (bind → arrow function), but there are 9+ files and 50+ call sites, easily exceeding 150 lines. Converting class components fully to function components with hooks would be the idiomatic modern React fix but is a much larger refactor.
